name: Password Sign-In MFA Required
summary: Accepts a valid password for an MFA-enabled durable identity without issuing an authenticated application session and directs the client to complete TOTP proof.

guards.expression: password authentication is accepted and the account requires a second factor before application sign-in can complete

sourceReferences.note: Maps Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.SignInResult.RequiresTwoFactor to AuthenticationResponseState.MfaRequired without completing application sign-in.
Emits this transition when the successful manager result carries AuthenticationResponseState.MfaRequired.
Allows the MFA-required transition through the stable password-login application boundary.
